summary.text: Sandy Pickert is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 88 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A registered nurse, she faces Democrat Candace Landers in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Sandy Pickert was born in Salina, Kansas, and graduated from Minneapolis High School.

She graduated from the St. Joseph School of Nursing in 1973, earned a bachelor's degree from St. Mary of the Plains College in 1981 and earned a graduate degree from the University of Kansas School of Medicine in 2007.
Her career experience includes working as a registered nurse.
Pickert assumed office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2023, succeeding Chuck Schmidt.
